newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek FRNs 2003 end up, ecu/drachma slips late.
newsitem.headline: Greek FRNs 2003 end up, ecu/drachma slips late.

text.p: Profit-taking sales were seen in January seven-year taxable, fixed coupon bonds, but there was buying in FRNs with a 2003 maturity, dealers said.
"There was some profit-taking in taxable fixed-coupon bonds and 7-year FRNs by investors from abroad, but trading was thin," an ABN AMRO Bank bond dealer said.
A bond dealer at a state bank said bond prices did not change much in a quiet session.
Money market rates held steady. Most forex forwards activity was in tomorrow/next funds, which slipped, dealers said.
"Deposits were stable late on Thursday. (Tomorrow/next) was the only swap which was trading heavily at lower prices," said a money market dealer at a state bank.
The central bank kept its intervention rate in overnight money unchanged at 11.90 percent.
The mark was quoted at 156.30/40 from Thursday's 156.270 fix, the dollar at 264.10/20 drachmas from 263.830 and the Ecu at 303.68/78 from 303.620 drachmas.

"The ecu rose to 303.71 during the session when a bank placed a large order to buy ecus. After the fixing, however, it fell and was trading between 303.00 and 303.22 late on Thursday," a forex dealer at Bank of Athens, said.
